senses.gloss:
खणखणाय खणखणाय (an onomato-
poetic word), A. खणखणायते, -यितुम्, to utter
or give out any peculiar sound; to tick, tinkle,
crack, &c.
खणखणायमान, अस्, आ, अम्, tinkling, &c.

खण्ड् खण्ड्, cl. 1. A., 10. P. खण्डते,
डितुम्, खण्डयति, -यितुम्, to break,
tear, break in pieces, crush, cut, divide; destroy,
annihilate, defeat, conquer; disappoint, frustrate,
interrupt, disturb, deceive, cheat.

खण्ड, अस्, आ, अम्, broken, torn asunder, divided,
having chasms, gaps, or breaks; deficient, defective,
crippled; (अस्, अम्), m. n. a break, a gap, a chasm,
a fissure, a fracture (e. g. केदार-खण्ड, a gap or
fracture in the embankment of a field); a piece,
part, fragment, portion; a section of a work, part,
chapter; a party number, multitude, assemblage; a
term in an equation; (अस्), m. treacle or molasses
partially dried, candied sugar; a flaw in a jewel; N.
of a people; (अम्), n. a kind of salt (विड्-लवण),
black salt; a sort of sugar-cane; [cf. उत्तर-खण्ड,
कर्क˚, काल˚, काशी˚.]
—खण्ड-कटक, अस् or
अम्, m. or n. (?), title of an astronomical work com-
posed by Brahma-gupta.
—खण्ड-कथा, f. a
fragmentary tale; a tale or story divided into
sections (?).
—खण्ड-कर्ण, अस्, m. a kind of
bulbous plant; sweet potato.
—खण्ड-काव्य, अम्,
n. a fragmentary poem; a poem interspersed with
prose (?).
—खण्ड-गिरि, इस्, m., N. of a mountain.
—खण्ड-ज, अस्, m. a kind of sugar, treacle,
molasses, = गुड, यवास-शर्करा.
—खण्ड-
जोद्भवज (˚ज-उद्˚), अस्, m. a kind of candied
sugar prepared from Khaṇḍaja.
—खण्ड-ता, f. the
being divided, division.
—खण्ड-देव, अस्, m., N.
of the author of a commentary on Jaimini's Nyāya-
sūtras, called Bhāṭṭadīpikā; also of the Mīmāṃsā-
Kaustubha.
—खण्ड-द्रव्य, अस्, m., N. of a man.
—खण्ड-धारा, f. shears, scissors; a kind of
dance or air (?).
—खण्ड-पत्त्र, अम्, n. a bundle
of various leaves.
—खण्ड-परशु, उस्, m. an
epithet of Śiva as cutting his foes to pieces with his
axe.
—खण्ड-पर्शु, उस्, m. a N. of Śiva; of
Paraśu-rāma; of Rāhu; an elephant with a broken
tusk; a spreader of unguents or fragrant powders &c.;
a drug, commonly called Khandāmalaki (see खण्डा-
मलक).
—खण्ड-पाणि, इस्, m., N. of a prince.
—खण्ड-पाल, अस्, m. a confectioner, seller of
sweetmeats (for खण्ड-पाण?).
—खण्ड-प्र-
लय, अस्, m. a partial destruction of the universe in
which all the spheres beneath Svarga or heaven are
dissolved in one common ruin; a quarrel; the dis-
solution of the bands of friendship or of society; (in
the latter sense more correctly खण्ड-प्रणय.)
—खण्ड-प्रशस्ति, इस्, f., N. of a poem attributed
to Hanumat; an older N. for the play Hanuman-nā-
ṭaka.
—खण्ड-फण, अस्, m. a kind of serpent.
—खण्ड-मण्डल, अम्, n. a segment of a circle,
part of a circle, an incomplete sphere; (अस्, आ, अम्),
gibbous, not full or round.
—खण्ड-मय, अस्, ई,
अम्, consisting of pieces.
—खण्ड-मोदक, अस्,
m. a kind of sugar, granulated or candied (यवास-
शर्करा).
—खण्ड-लवण, अम्, n. a kind of salt
(विड्-लवण), black salt.
—खण्ड-शर्करा, f.
[]
candied sugar or sugar in pieces.
—खण्ड-शस्, ind.
in pieces, by pieces, bit by bit, piece by piece, piece-
meal; खण्डशः कृ, to divide or cut into pieces;
खण्डशो भू, to be divided, to be separated into
pieces.
—खण्ड-शाखा, f., N. of a plant, = महि-
ष-वल्ली.
—खण्ड-शीला, f. a loose woman, an un-
chaste wife.
—खण्ड-सर, अस्, m. a kind of sugar
(यवास-शर्करा), candied sugar.
—खण्डाभ्र
(˚ड-अभ्˚), अम्, n. scattered clouds; a bite, the
impression of the teeth in amorous sport.
—खण्डा-
मलक (ड-आम्˚), अम्, n. myrobalan cut up into
small pieces (to be used as a medicine).
—खण्डाली
(˚ड-आली), f. a measure for oil; a pond; a woman
whose husband has been guilty of infidelity.

खाण्ड खाण्ड, अम्, n. (fr. खण्ड), the
state of having fractures, fissures, or gaps.

खण्डक, अस्, आ, अम्, breaking to pieces, de-
stroying, removing, rendering ineffectual; (अस्, अम्),
m. n. a fragment, a part, a piece; (अस्), m. treacle
or molasses partially dried, candied sugar; one who
has no nails; pared or clipped finger-nails (?); N. of
a metre, = आर्या-गीति; a kind of dance or tune (?);
[cf. खण्ड-धारा.]
—खण्डकालु or खण्ड-
कालुक (˚क-आलु), अम्, n. an esculent root, sweet
potato.

खण्डन, अस्, आ, अम्, breaking, dividing, cutting,
reducing to pieces, destroying, annihilating, removing;
(अम्), n. the act of breaking or cutting or dividing,
hurting, injuring, injury; interrupting, disappointing,
frustrating; cheating, deceiving; refuting (in argu-
ment); rebellion, opposition; discarding, dismissal.
—खण्डन-कार, अस्, m. an epithet of Harṣa.
—खण्डन-कृत्, त्, m., N. of an author.
—खण्डन-खण्डकाद्य (˚क-आद्˚), अम्, n. title
of a work on logic by Harṣa.
—खण्डन-रत, अस्,
आ, अम्, skilful in cutting or destroying, destructive.

खण्डनीय or खण्डितव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be
broken or divided, frangible, fragile, brittle; destruc-
tible, refutable, &c.

खण्डल or खण्डव, अस्, अम्, m. n. a piece,
a part.

खाण्डिक, अस्, m. (fr. खण्ड), a confectioner,
a seller of sugar-plums or sweetmeats; (अम्), n. a
mass or multitude of peas (fr. खण्डिक).

खण्डित, अस्, आ, अम्, cut, torn, broken in pieces,
scattered, dispersed, destroyed; broken as allegiance,
disobeyed against, rebelled; refuted, controverted;
disappointed, betrayed, abandoned as a lover; (आ), f.
a woman whose husband or lover has been guilty of
infidelity.
—खण्डित-विग्रह, अस्, आ, अम्, maimed,
mutilated.
—खण्डित-वृत्त, अस्, आ, अम्, one whose
manner of life is dissolute, an immoral man.
—खण्-
डिताशंस (˚त-आश्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, disappointed, foiled,
frustrated.

खण्डिन्, ई, इनी, इ, consisting of pieces, in pieces
or parts; divided, comminuted; (ई), m. a wild kind
of kidney-bean, = Vana-mudga; a N. of Harṣa;
(इनी), f. the earth.

खण्डी-कृ, cl. 8. P. A. -करोति, -कुरुते, -कर्-
तुम्, to divide or break into small pieces, to cut up,
tear to pieces &c.

खण्डीर, अस्, m. a kind of kidney-bean, Pīta-
mudga.
खण्डु = खण्ड, a kind of sugar (?).
खण्डेराय, अस्, m., N. of an author.

खण्ड्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be broken or divided,
fragile, destructible, &c.

खण्वखा खण्वखा, f. (an onomatopoetic
word), Ved., N. of a frog.

खाण्डव, अस्, m. (fr. खण्डु), sugar-candy,
sugar-plums, sweetmeats; N. of a region; (अम्), n.,
N. of a forest in Kuru-kṣetra, sacred to Indra and
burnt by the god of fire, Agni, with the assistance
of Arjuna and Kṛṣṇa (see Mahā-bh. I. 8207).
—खाण्डव-प्रस्थ, अस्, m., N. of a town
situated in the Khāṇḍava forest, founded by the
Pāṇḍavas, = इन्द्र-प्रस्थ.

खाण्डवायन, आस्, m. pl., N. of a family of
Brāhmans.
खाण्डविक, अस्, m. a confectioner; sugar-baker.
खाण्डिकीय, आस्, m. pl. the followers of Khaṇḍika.

खाण्डिक्य, अस्, m., N. of a son of Amita-dhvaja
or Mita-dhvaja; (अम्), n. the business of a con-
fectioner (?).

खण्ड-काव्य, अम्, n.; add — a partial or minor
poem (i. e. one not on any heroic or sacred subject,
and having only one topic).
